outfits.winter: a cream felt beret with a pure white daisy and two green leaves, a honey-yellow wool coat with toggle buttons, a long cream knitted scarf, dark brown tights, brown fur-trimmed boots, a moss-green satchel on a thin brown leather strap worn crossbody over the coat.
